title: A survey of diversity quantification in natural language processing: The why, what, where and how
abstract: arXiv:2507.20858v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The concept of diversity received increasing attention in natural language processing (NLP) in recent years. It became an advocated property of datasets and systems, with many measures used to quantify it, but also many cross-paper inconsistencies. To address this fragmentation, we take inspiration from other scientific fields where diversity has been more thoroughly conceptualized. We build upon (Sarkar, 2010) and (Stirling, 2007), two unified cross-domain frameworks inspired from ecology, economy and other domains. The first one advocates explicit justification of diversity endorsement. The latter distinguishes three dimensions of diversity: variety, balance, and disparity. translated_title: 自然语言处理中多样性量化的综述：为什么、是什么、在哪里以及如何
translated_abstract: 近年来，多样性（diversity）的概念在自然语言处理（NLP）领域受到了越来越多的关注。它已成为数据集和系统所推崇的一种属性，人们使用了许多度量方法来量化它，但论文之间也存在许多不一致之处。为了解决这种碎片化问题，我们从多样性概念化更为深入的其他科学领域中汲取灵感。我们借鉴了（Sarkar, 2010）和（Stirling, 2007）这两个受生态学、经济学和其他领域启发的统一跨领域框架。前者主张对多样性认同进行明确的论证，后者区分了多样性的三个维度：丰富度、均衡性和差异性。通过调研 ACL Anthology 中 300 多篇近期与多样性相关的论文，我们提出了一个 NLP 专用框架，包含 4 个视角：为什么多样性重要、用什么来衡量多样性、在哪里衡量多样性以及如何衡量。我们发现，在 NLP 中，丰富度（最简单的……（摘要不完整，在“丰富度”处截断）
tldr: 该论文借鉴生态学与经济学的跨领域统一框架，调研了300多篇NLP多样性相关文献，提出了涵盖“为什么重要、衡量对象、衡量位置、衡量方法”四个视角的NLP多样性量化专用框架，以解决该领域度量标准碎片化和不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: Drawing on unified cross-domain frameworks from ecology and economics, this paper surveys over 300 diversity-related NLP papers and proposes an NLP-specific framework with four perspectives—why diversity matters, what it is measured on, where, and how—to address fragmentation and inconsistencies in diversity quantification across the field.
